description:
Beneath the grand Alvard manor, a chained beast named Desi lives in darkness. Unable to ignore his daily torment, Celi secretly feeds him and slowly earns his trust. When the count orders his death, she sets him free—but Desi refuses to leave her, and their forbidden, hidden life together begins.

[Original Webtoon](https://ridibooks.com/books/6015000001)
